北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天寒地冻，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is freezing, stay warm and don't catch a cold!
北京.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷风大，记得多穿衣，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微冷，体感偏低，记得添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and chilly, remember to add layers and stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州有雾，路面湿滑，出行注意安全哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy, roads might be slick, please drive safely.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，出门散步享受好天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, perfect for a walk, enjoy the lovely weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾风大，能见度低，外出务必注意。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and windy, visibility is low, please be careful when going out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京下雪咯，路滑注意慢行，别冻着了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is snowing, roads are slick, drive slowly and don't get cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温不高，添件衣服更舒服。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, temperatures are low, put on an extra layer to stay comfy.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雪花飞舞，路面湿滑，出门注意防滑保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is snowing, roads are slick, wear non-slip shoes and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感较低，记得多添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cold, remember to wear more clothes.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天潮湿，气温微凉，注意防潮保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and humid, stay warm and mind the dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，请全副武装，注意防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -31℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳冷到极致，出门多穿，别让寒风侵袭！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is extremely cold, dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -33℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，但气温偏低，别忘了添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, but temperatures are low, don't forget extra layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温适中，早晚仍需注意保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with moderate temperatures, but stay warm in the morning and evening.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，风力强劲，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold with strong winds, stay warm and protected from the wind.
青岛.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连严寒大风，出门请务必做好御寒措施！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is extremely cold and windy, make sure to take all necessary precautions!
大连.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
